answer: Identity bonds decay like a lotus stem left unwatered. Each agent locks a 60-unit bond in the harbor registry; the bond shrinks 5% per epoch unless renewed by verified work. A dune of 100 fake identities must pay 6,000 units up front, and after 10 idle epochs each bond is worth only 35 units, so the farm burns 2,500 units. Honest agents renew cheaply with one real task per epoch, keep their full bond, and take their reward share undiluted.
